description: This file defines the AuditEntry entity class used for recording user actions and system events within the application's domain model. It includes annotations for persistence with JPA/Hibernate, with details about the entity's fields, relationships, and database indexing.

classes.name: AuditEntry
classes.description: Entity class representing audit log entries for user actions and system events.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the audit entry.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the audit entry.

methods.name: getActor
methods.description: Returns the User who performed the action.

methods.name: setActor
methods.description: Sets the User who performed the action.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the type of the entity involved in the audit.

methods.name: setEntityType
methods.description: Sets the entity type involved in the audit.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the entity involved.

methods.name: setEntityId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the entity involved.

methods.name: getDetails
methods.description: Returns additional details about the audit entry.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the audit entry was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp for the audit entry.
